title: Outcomes of Low-Impact Exercise Program for People With Ankle, Knee, and/or Hip Pain
official: Outcomes of Low-Impact Group Exercise Program for People With Ankle, Knee, and/or Hip Pain
summary: The primary objective of this study is to study how low-impact group exercise classes affect pain scores in patients with knee, hip, and ankle pain when paired with concurrent standard of care dietitian and behavioral health consults.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 18 and over
* Ability to attend classes 3x weekly for 6 months with at least a 66% attendance rate
* Ability to concurrently attend standard of care dietitian and behavioral health classes for 6 months
* Joint pain (knee, ankle, hip)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant
* Prisoners
